name: @wildshard/engine
description: The Wildshard engine: one repo with shared, client, server and cook code and three build targets (client, dedicated server, standalone listen server), shaped like Unreal or Source.

scripts.pnpm:devPreinstall: git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:kit && pnpm gen:inputs && npr tsc -b tsconfig.layers.json --builders 8
scripts.format: npr oxfmt -c src/.oxfmtrc.json src/cli src/tools src/e2e src/scripts
scripts.format:check: npr oxfmt -c src/.oxfmtrc.json --check src/cli src/tools src/e2e src/scripts
scripts.check:saves: env -u WS_PUSH_GATE_PROFILE -u WS_CPU_ADMISSION vitest run test/saves-lock.test.ts
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm check:sides && pnpm check:asks && pnpm check:agents && pnpm check:agent-sync && pnpm test:agent-hooks && pnpm check:parity && pnpm check:page-events && pnpm check:wire && pnpm check:saves
scripts.typecheck:kit: npr tsc -p src/tsconfig.json && npr tsc -p src/client/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:fast: python3 scripts/heavy-lane.py full-test -- node scripts/vitest-tmp.ts run
scripts.build:ring: python3 scripts/heavy-lane.py build -- bash -c 'node scripts/pins.ts install --ring 1 && node scripts/gen.mjs --inputs-only && WILDSHARD_CATALOGUE=out/.ring-catalogue.json node scripts/build-app.mjs && node scripts/check-devserver.mjs dist'
scripts.test:checks: pnpm gen && node scripts/check-graph.mjs --source-only && node scripts/check-engine-sides.mjs && node scripts/check-sim-players.mjs
scripts.build:game: python3 scripts/heavy-lane.py build -- bash -c 'node scripts/pins.ts install && node scripts/gen.mjs --inputs-only && npr tsc -b tsconfig.layers.json --builders 1 && WILDSHARD_CATALOGUE=test/pins/catalogue.json node scripts/build-app.mjs && node scripts/check-devserver.mjs dist && node scripts/app-build/splitOutput.mjs dist && node scripts/page-size.mjs dist --gate'
